name: MR Drone Simulator
summary:
Master drone flying in minutes—no crashes, no consequences.
MR Drone Simulator: Learn to Fly is a beginner-friendly mixed reality simulator built for Meta Quest. It blends your real-world surroundings with immersive training missions, teaching you how to fly a virtual drone safely and confidently.
Whether you're a new drone owner, a student, or just curious about drone tech, this is the perfect starting point.
 Key Features:
Mixed Reality Training: Fly a virtual drone in your own space using passthrough
